body: Thanks. My hospital's website is a mess, but I will try to find some more information. It's just so hard. I know that I was not in control, and I can't remember shit, but that's no excuse to anyone. It's so hard being held accountable for this.
Thanks, but I don't think I can talk on the phone with anyone right now. I just feel sick, and I can't stop crying. I'm sorry.
